# js-sequence-diagrams 1.0.6

`sequence-diagram-min.js` is the unmodified v1.0.6 build from
https://github.com/bramp/js-sequence-diagrams (tag `v1.0.6`, `build/sequence-diagram-min.js`),
under the Simplified BSD licence in `LICENCE`.

Typora draws ```sequence fences with this version (the 2.x rewrite on npm lays diagrams
out differently), so Marpora uses it too. `src/diagram.ts` applies Typora's colour
changes when it loads the script.
